error.message: The loop through MIXER1, CP1, HE1, FLASH1, CP2, VALVE3, HE2, FLASH2, CP3, VALVE2, HE3, MIXER2, HE4, SPLIT1, HE5, REACTOR1, REACTOR2, HE6, TRACES, MIXER3, HE7, FLASH4, COLUMN, FLASH3, SPLIT3, MIX-TOP, SPLIT2, VALVE1, MIXER5, CPREC, MIXER4 did not converge: at iteration 2, Heat exchanger HE5: Temperature cross: where 83500 kW of 98230 kW has left the hot side, the hot side is at 72.11 °C and the cold side at 72.28 °C. Heat cannot flow there: lower the duty, change an outlet. (on an accelerated guess, broyden, 4.8e-16 % of the tear flows beyond the last pass's result; the last pass changed the tears by 1.55e-1. Check the specifications and the start values of the loop first; direct substitution, which never extrapolates, shows whether the guess was the cause). What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear streams (19, 35, 26, 28, 39-REC) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
